# SSMG Travels Gorakhpur

> SSMG Travels is Gorakhpur's premier travel agency and taxi operator specializing in customized Nepal Tour Packages, Sunauli Border Permit Clearance, Ayodhya Ram Mandir Yatras, Kashi Vishwanath Varanasi Tours, and 24/7 Outstation Cab Rentals.

## Core Specializations
- **Nepal Tour Packages**: Pokhara, Kathmandu, Muktinath, Manakamana Devi, Chitwan Jungle Safari, Lumbini (Birthplace of Lord Buddha).
- **Indo-Nepal Sunauli Border Assistance**: Complete clearance of vehicle customs (Bhansar) and road permits (Suvidha) by experienced mountain chauffeurs.
- **Car Rental & Outstation Cabs**: Clean, sanitized, AC vehicles for one-way, round-trip, airport and railway transfers from Gorakhpur.
- **Spiritual Pilgrimage Circuits**: Ayodhya Ram Mandir, Varanasi Kashi Vishwanath, Prayagraj Triveni Sangam, Janakpur Dham.

## Fleet & Cab Options
- [Gorakhpur Taxi Services](https://ssmgtravels.in/taxi-services.html):
  - **Maruti Suzuki Dzire**: 4-seater comfortable sedan for couples & small families.
  - **Toyota Innova Crysta**: 6/7-seater luxury SUV with superior comfort on mountain routes.
  - **Maruti Ertiga**: 6-seater economical family MPV.
  - **Tempo Traveller**: 9, 12, 17, 20, and 26-seater AC luxury minibuses for groups and pilgrims.

## Essential Travel Guidelines
- **Identification for Indian Citizens**: No visa is required. Indian adults need a valid Voter ID card or Passport. Minors require a Birth Certificate or school photo ID.
- **Border Formalities**: Sunauli border vehicle permits (Bhansar & Suvidha) are fully managed by SSMG Travels drivers.
- **Currency Accepted**: Indian Rupee (INR) notes of ₹10, ₹20, ₹50, and ₹100 are widely accepted across Nepal.
